requirements.quote: Deliver DAP Veyra receiving dock, Chakan Industrial Area, Pune 410501, India, Incoterms 2020. Buyer unloads and, for imports, performs import clearance and pays import duties/taxes.
requirements.text: Deliver goods to specified dock in Pune under DAP Incoterms 2020.

requirements.quote: Quote origin, route, named carrier, transit time and separate duty assumptions.
requirements.text: Provide origin, route, carrier, transit time, and duty assumptions.

requirements.quote: Exact dock confirmed on PO.
requirements.text: Dock details confirmed in purchase order.

requirements.quote: Use individually ESD-protected units with all accessories; recyclable cushioning and labelled cartons <=15 kg. No mixed hardware/firmware revisions per carton.
requirements.text: Package items with ESD protection, recyclable cushioning, and labeled cartons under 15 kg.

requirements.quote: ISTA 2A report; unit/carton artwork and packing specification.
requirements.text: Provide ISTA 2A report and packaging specifications.

requirements.quote: Send advance shipping notice (ASN) 48 h before delivery with PO line, quantity, serial range, revision, weight, dimensions and tracking.
requirements.text: Send ASN 48 hours before delivery with specified details.

requirements.quote: On-time delivery >=98% of PO lines per calendar month; early delivery >3 days requires approval.
requirements.text: Ensure 98% on-time delivery monthly; early delivery over 3 days needs approval.

requirements.quote: Buyer may inspect within ten business days of receipt. Wrong, damaged or nonconforming units may be rejected with evidence.
requirements.text: Buyer can inspect and reject nonconforming items within 10 business days.

requirements.quote: Payment/use does not waive latent-defect claims.
requirements.text: Payment does not waive claims for latent defects.

requirements.quote: Supplier bears collection, repair/replacement and redelivery cost for attributable defects.
requirements.text: Supplier covers costs for defects.

requirements.quote: Provide repair capability and spare-component availability for five years after last production shipment.
requirements.text: Maintain repair and spare parts availability for 5 years post-production.

requirements.quote: Propose annual repair prices and last-time-buy arrangements.
requirements.text: Submit annual repair pricing and last-time-buy plans.

requirements.quote: Service plan, location, capacity, failure-analysis process and named escalation roles.
requirements.text: Provide service plan details including location, capacity, and escalation roles.

requirements.quote: Provide a 24-month warranty from delivery covering design defects within supplier scope, workmanship and materials.
requirements.text: Offer 24-month warranty for design, workmanship, and materials.

requirements.quote: Acknowledge a return-material authorisation (RMA) request in two business days.
requirements.text: Respond to RMA requests within 2 business days.

requirements.quote: Complete failure analysis in ten business days and repair or replace within 20 business days after receipt.
requirements.text: Perform failure analysis in 10 days and repair/replace in 20 days.

requirements.quote: Repaired/replaced units carry the remaining original warranty or 90 days, whichever is longer.
requirements.text: Repaired/replaced items retain original warranty or 90 days.

requirements.quote: For a dead-on-arrival report within 30 days, dispatch an advance replacement within five business days after buyer supplies basic diagnostic evidence.
requirements.text: Replace DOA items within 5 days of diagnostic evidence.

requirements.quote: Damage caused by documented misuse or operation outside specified limits is excluded.
requirements.text: Warranty excludes misuse or operation outside limits.

requirements.quote: No-fault-found charges require agreed diagnostics and buyer approval before invoicing.
requirements.text: No-fault charges need agreed diagnostics and buyer approval.

requirements.quote: A common-cause failure affecting more than 1% of a production lot, or any safety-related incident, triggers joint containment.
requirements.text: Contain failures affecting over 1% of a lot or safety incidents.

requirements.quote: Notify buyer within 24 hours of discovery; identify affected serials and stop further affected shipments.
requirements.text: Notify buyer within 24 hours and halt affected shipments.

requirements.quote: Supplier shall fund attributable sorting, repair and replacement under the agreed liability terms.
requirements.text: Supplier funds sorting, repair, and replacement for defects.

requirements.quote: Buyer controls field communications and any recall decision.
requirements.text: Buyer manages field communications and recalls.

requirements.quote: Report monthly: deliveries due/achieved, incoming rejects, production first-pass yield, RMA rate by failure code, corrective actions and open shortages.
requirements.text: Provide monthly reports on deliveries, rejects, yield, RMA rates, and shortages.

requirements.quote: Delivery performance uses the buyer-confirmed due date; exclude documented buyer-caused delays only by written agreement.
requirements.text: Delivery performance based on buyer-confirmed due date; exclude buyer delays by agreement.
